# SceneScaffold

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/SceneScaffold.cs#L19)

The marker hierarchy every VR Framework scene is built on, plus the helpers installers use
to place themselves.
Markers are dashed separators sitting at the scene root, and the objects that belong to a
marker are root objects listed after it - a flat hierarchy, as in section 9 of the
architecture document and in the shipped scenes. They are not parents. Everything here
works on the active scene only, so an install never lands in a different loaded scene.
